items.text: Your salary, steady contract work, or stable income base that pays for life right now.

items.heading: Inside the Coaching Dashboard,
items.text: Inside the coaching dashboard, the rule is deliberately conservative: do not quit a safe job until the side engine is making about 1.5 to 2 times your salary for a sustained stretch , and keep a meaningful cash buffer before resigning.

items.heading: Raffiee and Feng, Academy
items.text: Raffiee and Feng, Academy of Management Journal found that hybrid entrepreneurs who later moved full-time into self-employment had higher survival rates than people who moved directly from employment into full-time self-employment.

items.heading: Raffiee and Feng Paper Copy
items.text: Raffiee and Feng paper copy is useful if you want the full study behind the hybrid-entry idea.

items.heading: Staged Entrepreneurship Research Overview Reinforces
items.text: Staged entrepreneurship research overview reinforces the idea that many people transition through a hybrid phase rather than through an immediate clean break.
